{{Quote|What's this all about?''"<br />"''What's it always about at this end of the Core. The Diamala and Ishori are at it again.''"<br />"''Let me guess. Commerce and resource-sharing dispute?''"<br />"''Close. This time it's shipping security. The Diamala don't like having to rely on local patrol ships when they're coming into Ishori ports. The Ishori, on the other hand, don't want armed Diamala ships coming into their systems.|Luke Skywalker and Han Solo|<ref name="Specter of the Past">''[[Specter of the Past]]''</ref>}}
The '''Diamala''' (singular '''Diamal''') were a [[Species/Legends|species]] from the planet [[Diamal (planet)|Diamal]], in the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]], who, along with their rivals the [[Ishori]], became prominent during the crises over the [[Caamas Document]] and the [[Flim (Human)|apparent]] return of [[Grand Admiral/Legends|Grand Admiral]] [[Mitth'raw'nuruodo/Legends|Thrawn]]. Diamala were recognizable by their leathery skin, white manes, and fan-shaped ears, which they could move independently to gesture with. The Diamala temperament was generally calm and unemotional, with a strong sense of personal pride. They had extensive financial and business holdings, which they attributed to hard work rather than luck.<ref name="Specter of the Past" />

In [[19 ABY/Legends|19 ABY]], the Diamala objected when the Ishori refused to allow armed Diamalan vessels to escort Diamalan freighters into Ishori ports. The [[Iphigini]] offered to help resolve this dispute. [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]], [[Chewbacca/Legends|Chewbacca]], and [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]], who acted as mediators during initial negotiations, were unable to help the two species reach an agreement. The rift between the two species only worsened when they took opposite sides on the dispute over the Caamas Document.<ref name="Specter of the Past" /> While the Ishori were among the loudest voices demanding that the [[Bothan/Legends|Bothans]] pay ruinious reparations for complicity in the destruction of [[Caamas/Legends|Caamas]], the Diamala sent [[Nebula-class Star Destroyer|''Nebula-'']] and [[Endurance-class fleet carrier|''Endurance'']]-class ships to defend [[Bothawui/Legends|Bothawui]]. The Diamalan fleet also included twelve [[Marauder-class Assault Corvette/Legends|''Marauder''-class]] [[Corvette/Legends|corvettes]], a group of which were involved in operations against the [[Imperial Remnant/Legends|Imperial Remnant]] during the crisis (though they were ostensibly purchased by their [[Diamalan Commerce Ministry|Commerce Ministry]] as freighter escorts).<ref name="Vision of the Future">''[[Vision of the Future]]''</ref>

Their representative to the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] [[New Republic Senate/Legends|Senate]] in 19 ABY, [[Porolo Miatamia]], was accused by politicians on the other side of being as manipulative as the Bothans themselves.<ref name="Specter of the Past" />
